pricingTiers.name: Core (1–40 users)
pricingTiers.notes: Displayed $119/month billed yearly; annual total119×12=$1,428. Monthly billing amount not independently retrieved. Free plan up to5users/10courses separate.

pricingTiers.name: Pro (1–100 users)
pricingTiers.notes: Official card marked Popular. Displayed $449/month billed yearly; annual total449×12=$5,388. Flex/additional-user charges and add-ons separate.

pricingTiers.name: Grow (1–70 users)
pricingTiers.notes: Closest expanding organization tier; $229/month billed yearly ×12=$2,748/year. Higher user brackets priced separately.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Custom annual plan; card says1000users, flexible starts500; FAQ allows tailored user counts. No universal minimum or numeric price asserted.

moats.claim: Reusable training content, branch portals and connected HR workflows can make an established employee/customer learning program costly to migrate.

productReasons.claim: SCORM1.2, TinCan/xAPI and cmi5 support let organizations reuse standards-based learning content.
Branches and learning paths organize different teams or audiences into separate, sequenced training experiences.
AI course creation, coaching and skill-based learning tools help authors produce material and guide learner practice.
